survey: A handheld calculator shown alone on a flat orange background, tilted toward the camera. Main parts: (1) a rounded navy body, a single slab with even thickness visible along the left and bottom edges. (2) A light-grey display window set into the upper face, parallel to the body's top edge. (3) A red key or solar-strip bar on the face just above the display, next to the top edge. (4) A keypad of 12 navy keys in a 3-column by 4-row grid, plus a right-hand column of 4 cyan operator keys, one per row. All keys sit raised on the face and follow its perspective, with even spacing and none overlapping. Being an isolated icon, the calculator floats by design; there is no surface it should be resting on.
